observations: Photo 0 shows a boxed Xbox 360 Wireless Controller in its original packaging, with visible branding and multilingual text.
The box is white with green accents, and the controller is black with standard Xbox 360 color scheme (orange, blue, red, green buttons).
The front of the box states 'XBOX 360 WIRELESS CONTROLLER' and 'WIRELESS 2.4, COMPATIBLE PC'.
Photo 1 shows the back of the box with multilingual text, including 'CONTENTS: Wireless Controller, (2) AA Batteries'.
The back also states 'This label is only applicable to the following country/region: Taiwan' and includes a Microsoft address in Redmond, WA, USA.
The box appears to be sealed, with no visible damage or tampering.
The watermark 'COOL GADGETS STORES' is present on both photos.
